你可能不认识我们，因为我们已经十七年没有和你的父母说过话了！

Chandler: We used to be married, but then we missed a weekend away together and things kind of unraveled.
我们曾经结婚过，但后来我们错过了一起出去的周末，事情就破裂了。 Because of you!
全都是你害的！ Happy Birthday.
生日快乐。 (Ross looks disappointed and switches the camcorder off)

Monica: Ross, Rachel promised it would be over by now.
罗斯，瑞秋保证现在一切都会结束。 We seriously have to go, if we want to get to Vermont.
如果我们想去佛蒙特州，我们真的必须走。 I called them and the last train leaves in a half hour.
我给他们打电话，最后一班火车将在半小时后出发。

Phoebe: And you know, I have a massage client soon.
你知道，我很快就会有一个按摩客户。

Ross: You guys, just please..
你们，请.. a little bit longer.
再等一小会儿就好。 I promise, Rachel will be back with the cake any minute.
我保证，瑞秋随时都会带着蛋糕回来。 Monica, remember..
莫妮卡，记住.. the frosting?
糖霜？ huh?
嗯？

Monica: Alright, 5 more minutes.
好的，还有 5 分钟。

(The phone rings, Ross picks up)

Ross: (Into receiver) Hello?
（对着听筒）喂？ (listens) Oh no!
（听）哦不！ What happened?
发生了什么？ (listens some more) Ok ok, where are you?
（再听一些）好吧好吧，你在哪里？ (Grabs a pen and starts writing).
（拿起笔开始写）。 Ok, I'll be right there.
好的，我马上就到。 (Puts the phone down)

Chandler: Was that Emma?
那是艾玛吗？ Is she up?
她起来了吗？

Ross: No, Rachel got pulled over for speeding.
不，瑞秋因超速被拦下。 She forgot her licence so now I have to bring it to her.
她忘带驾照了，我得送过去。

Phoebe: Well, if you're leaving, I'm definitely gonna go.
好吧，既然你要走，我也一定会走。

Monica: No!
不！ Wait!
等待！ If anybody gets to go..
如果有人去的话.. it's us (Points at herself and Chandler) We've been complaining the longest!
是我们（指着自己和钱德勒）我们抱怨的时间最长！

Ross: No, wait !
不，等等！ You guys, no, no, you can't leave!
你们，不，不，你们不能走！ Rachel already feels bad that the cake's messed up.
瑞秋已经因为蛋糕搞砸了而感到难过。 How do you think she's gonna feel when she comes back here and all you guys are gone?
你认为当她回到这里而你们都走了之后她会有什么感觉？

Chandler: I don't know!
我不知道！ You'll tell us on Monday!
周一你就会告诉我们！

Ross: Joey!
乔伊！ You're in charge, ok?
你负责，好吗？ You make sure nobody leaves!
你确保没有人离开！ (leaves)

Joey: Got it!
知道了！ (Goes towards the front door and stands with his back to it) Hey hey hey!
（走到前门，背对着门站着）嘿嘿嘿！ (to Chandler) Where do you think you're going?
（对钱德勒）你认为你要去哪里？

Chandler: To the bathroom!
去卫生间！

Joey: Alright, well the rest of you get comfortable, ok, because we're gonna be here for a li...(stops and thinks) Wait a minute, there is a window in there!
好吧，那么你们其他人就舒服一点吧，好吧，因为我们要在这里待一段时间……（停下来思考）等一下，那里有一扇窗户！

Phoebe: Oh no!
哦不！ He's not getting away that easy!
他没那么容易逃走！ (Phoebe and Joey run towards the bathroom and enter)

Chandler: (Yelling) What are you doing?
（大喊）你在做什么？ Get the hell out of here!
赶紧离开这里！ (Phoebe and Joey come out looking shocked)

Joey: Well, that one did not have Emma's face on it.
嗯，那个上面没有艾玛的脸。

Phoebe: No, it did not.
不，没有。

Joey: No.
不。

Judy: Well, we better get going, it's late.
好吧，我们最好走了，已经很晚了。 Jack's not allowed to drive at night anymore.
杰克不再被允许在夜间开车。 He has trouble staying in his lane.
他很难留在自己的车道上。

Jack: Last winter I went up on a church lawn and drove right through a manger scene.
去年冬天，我开上教堂的草坪，直接撞穿了耶稣诞生的布景。 The papers thought it was a hate crime.
报纸认为这是一起仇恨犯罪。

Judy: Anyway, it was lovely seeing you.
不管怎样，很高兴见到你。

Joey: Ok!
好的！ (Opens the door for them)

Judy: Bye...
再见... Bye dear.
再见亲爱的。

Joey: Nighty-night!
晚安！

Judy: Nighty-night!
晚安！

Joey: Bye, bye.
再见，再见。

Phoebe: Joey?
乔伊？ How could you just let them leave?
你怎么可以让他们离开？

Joey: Hey, hey, hey, hey!
嘿嘿嘿嘿！ I'm not gonna mess with Jack, he's a great man, he fought for our country.
我不会惹杰克，他是一个伟大的人，他为我们的国家而战。

Monica: No, he didn't!
不，他没有！ He pretended to be a Quaker to get out of Korea.
才没有，他装成贵格会教徒，躲过了去朝鲜打仗。

Joey: (Shocked) Oh!
（震惊）哦！ Well that's it!
好吧，就是这样！ He's the last one to go.
他是最后一个走的人。 I'm locking you guys in.
我把你们锁在里面了 (turns the bolts of the door, thereby locking it)

Chandler: You do know, I can just turn them the other way around, right?
你知道，我可以把它们反过来，对吧？

Joey: Oh!
哦！ I forgot you used to live here!
我忘了你以前住在这里！

(The phone rings, Joey picks up)

Joey: Hello?
你好？

Estelle: (on the other side of the line) Joey!
（线路的另一边）乔伊！ It's Estelle!
是埃斯特尔！

Joey: Hey!
嘿！ (smiles)

Estelle: So, how did your audition go today?
那么，今天的试镜怎么样？

Joey: (smile fades) What audition?
（笑容消失）什么试镜？

Estelle: The one I told you about last week?
我上周告诉过你的那个？

Joey: What?
什么？ You never said anything about an audition!
你从来没有说过任何关于试镜的事情！

Estelle: (Looks confused) Let me start over.
（看起来很困惑）让我重新开始。 I just got a call about an audition.
我刚刚接到一个关于试镜的电话。 I think you can still make it.
我想你现在还赶得上。 It's down at the Astor Theatre and you need to have a monologue prepared.
演出地点在阿斯特剧院，你需要准备一段独白。

Joey: A monologue?
独白？ I don't have..
我没有.. (sees the book he was reading before for his "dramatic reading") I got it.
（看见刚才朗读的书）有了。 (hangs up) (announces to the room) Aah!
（挂断电话）（向房间通报）啊！ so...
所以... I'm gonna take off!
我要先走了！

Phoebe: Wh..
什.. what?
什么？ No wait, you don't get to leave!
不，等等，你不能离开！ I've got a massage client waiting outside my door any minute!
随时都有一位按摩客户在我门外等候！

Monica: Yeah, and we've paid for a room, that we're supposed to be in right now!
是的，我们已经付了房间费，我们现在就应该入住！

Phoebe: Well, oh, ok now...
嗯，哦，好吧，现在... Only one of us has to stay with Emma.
我们中只有一个人必须和艾玛在一起。 Ok, and as the person who realized that, I get to go!
好吧，作为意识到这一点的人，我得走了！

Monica: No!
不！ no!
不！ Let's figure out a fair way to decide who's staying.
让我们想出一个公平的方法来决定谁留下来。

Joey: Oh!
哦！ I got it!
我有办法了！ Ok, everyone pick a number from one to ten.
好的，每个人从一到十中选择一个数字。 Alright?
好吧？ Whoever gets the highest number gets to go first.
谁得到的数字最多，谁就先走。

Monica: (She gives Joey a you-are-so-stupid-look) Ok, ten.
（她给乔伊一个“你真傻”的表情）好吧，十个。

Joey: Okay, Monica picks ten, I call nine!
好吧，莫妮卡选十个，我选九个！ Anyone else?
还有其他人吗？

Phoebe: No, lets just draw straws.
不，咱们抽签吧。

Joey: Or..
或者.. we could flip a coin, and then multiply the..
我们可以抛一枚硬币，然后乘以......

Chandler: I'm begging you stop.
我求你停下来。

Joey: Right.
正确的。

Monica: Ok, how about this: We got wind up toys for Emma for her birthday.
好吧，这样怎么样：我们为艾玛准备了发条玩具作为她的生日礼物。 We can make them race, and whoever comes in last, stays!
我们可以让他们比赛，无论谁最后到达，都留下来！

Phoebe: (Visibly excited) Yeah!!
（明显兴奋）是啊！！ Let's do that!
让我们这样做吧！

Chandler: (Also very excited) That sounds more fun than the thing we were going to do in Vermont!
（也很兴奋）这听起来比我们在佛蒙特州要做的事情更有趣！

Monica: Everybody get your toys!
大家都去拿玩具吧！ (They all run toward the table with toys)

Phoebe: Ok!
好的！ I want the dolphin!
我想要海豚！

Chandler: Thats a bear.
那是一只熊。

Phoebe: I'm too excited!
我太兴奋了！

Monica: Phoebe, you get the bear, uhm, Joey, you get the robot, and Chandler and I get the dog.
菲比，你得到了熊，嗯，乔伊，你得到了机器人，钱德勒和我得到了狗。 Ok, and the race is going to go (Takes two cups and marks the start and finish lines with them) from here to here.
好，比赛路线是从这里到这里。（拿两个杯子标出起点和终点） Now the one who comes in last, stays!
现在最后进来的人留下来了！

Joey: Ok, ladies and gentlemen, wind your toys!
好了，各位，给玩具上发条！ (they do so)

Chandler: Ok, on your mark...
各就各位…… Get set...
准备好... GO!!!
跑！

(Monica, Phoebe and Joey release their wind-up toys.)

Phoebe: Go!
加油！ Go!
加油！

Joey: Come on robot!
机器人来吧！

(Phoebe's bear takes the lead, followed by Joey's robot, and far behind is Chandler and Monica's dog, which walks a few paces, stops and starts barking, sits, walks again, and so on... )

Monica: (to the dog) What are you barking at?
（对狗）你在吠什么？

(While Phoebe's bear is still in the lead, it is now closely followed by Joey's robot. Chandler and Monica's dog however, sits down, barking... and does a backflip.)

Monica: Wha...
什…… How the hell is that gonna help?
这到底有什么帮助？

Chandler: I bought you.
我买了你。 How did I forget that that's all you do?
我怎么忘了你所做的就是这些？

(Meanwhile the race has been won by Phoebe's bear, followed by Joey's robot)

Joey: Way to go robot!
机器人干得好！

Phoebe: Good job Alan!
干得好，艾伦！

Joey: Hey, good race you guys.
各位，比得不错。

Phoebe: Yeah, see you later!
是的，稍后见！

(Joey and Phoebe leave for the door)

Monica: No!
不！ No, no...
不，不…… wait!
等待！ We didn't lose.
我们没有输。 (turns to Chandler) The rules clearly stated that the last one to cross the finish line was the loser.
（转向钱德勒）规则明确规定，最后一个冲过终点线的人就是失败者。 Well, our dog never crossed the finish line, so technically...
好吧，我们的狗从未冲过终点线，所以从技术上来说......

Chandler: They left.
他们离开了。

(Monica turns to see the closed door.)

[ Scene: The freeway. Rachel is driving Monica's Porsche, while using her mobile phone. Ross is sitting next to her.]


Rachel: (into the phone) No, there isn't time to go to the bakery.
（对着电话）不，没时间去面包店。 We're just gonna come home...
我们只是要回家... Everybody left?
大家都走了吗？ Alright, well just tell Emma we're gonna be there as soon as we can.
好吧，我们就告诉艾玛我们会尽快赶到。 (emotionally) Bye...
（情绪激动地）再见……

(She hangs up, closes her phone, turns around and puts it in her bag which is in the back of the car. While doing this and not looking at the road, she turns the steering wheel by accident, which makes the car swerve.)

Ross: RACHEL!
瑞秋！

Rachel: OOH!
哦！ God!
上帝！ Sorry!
对不起！

Ross: (sarcastically) I can't believe they gave you a ticket.
（讽刺地）真不敢相信警察居然给你开罚单。 You're such a good driver.
你真是个好司机。

(Ross fastens his seat belt.)

Rachel: Emma's awake.
艾玛醒了。

Ross: Yeah?
是的？

Rachel: I can't believe this.
我简直不敢相信这一点。 This is her first birthday.
这是她的第一个生日。 She's awake.
她醒了。 We're not even there.
我们甚至不在那儿。 Everybody left.
大家都离开了。 We still have this stupid obscene cake.
我们还有这个愚蠢淫秽的蛋糕。

Ross: Hey, maybe I can fix that, you know.
嘿，也许我可以解决这个问题，你知道。 Try to turn it into something else.
尝试把它变成别的东西。 (he opens the box)

Rachel: Oh, why do you even bother?
唉，何必费这个劲？ I already ruined her first birthday...
我已经毁了她的第一个生日了... And do you know how important these early experiences are Ross?
你知道这些早期经历有多重要吗，罗斯？ Very!
非常！ According to the back cover of that book that you gave me.
根据你给我的那本书的封底。

Ross: Rach, she's not going to remember this.
瑞秋，她不会记得这件事的。

Rachel: (shakes her head) I guess...
（摇头）我想…… Oh, I just had such an idea of what this day would be like, you know?
唉，我本来对今天有那么美好的憧憬。 Emma laughing and everybody gathered around her cake singing "Happy Birthday".
艾玛笑了，每个人都聚集在她的蛋糕周围唱着“生日快乐”。 Then we would all go into...
然后我们都会进入... HEY GET OUT OF THE ROAD YOU STUPID STUDENT DRIVER!!!
喂，让开，你这个笨蛋学车的！ (honks furiously, and Ross looks at her in disbelief and Rachel looks at him.) They have to learn!
（愤怒地按喇叭，罗斯难以置信地看着她，瑞秋看着他。）他们必须学习！

Ross: (looks back at the cake) Hey!
（回头看着蛋糕）嘿！

Rachel: What?
什么？

Ross: It's not bad.
这还不错。

Rachel: (she looks at the cake) Oh my God!
（她看着蛋糕）天哪！ Look what...
看看，你居然…… you made it into a bunny.
你把它变成了一只兔子。 How did you do that?
你是怎么做到的？

Ross: Well, I just made these two things uhm...
嗯，我刚刚做了这两件事，嗯...... cheeks.
脸颊。 And then I split this to make ears.
然后我把它分开来做耳朵。

Rachel: Well, I'm very impressed.
嗯，我印象很深刻。

Ross: Some can sing, some can dance.
有的会唱歌，有的会跳舞。 I apparently can turn phallic cakes into woodland creatures.
显然我可以把阴茎蛋糕变成林地生物。

[ Scene: Rachel and Joey's apartment. Chandler, Monica and Emma are sitting on the floor, and Emma's stuffed animals are lined up in front of them.]


Monica: Now another way to organise your stuffed animals, is by size.
现在组织毛绒动物的另一种方法是按尺寸。

Chandler: I'm sorry, is this a game for Emma or for Monica?
抱歉，这是艾玛的游戏还是莫妮卡的游戏？

Monica: Game?
游戏？

Chandler: Emma, you even know it's your birthday today?
艾玛，你知道今天是你的生日吗？ You're one!
你一岁了！ One-year-old, that's little.
一岁了，还小。

(With his index finger he shows her how old she is. Emma also points her finger and babbles...)

Chandler: Ooh!
哦！ That's my girl!
那是我的女孩！

Monica: That's how old you are.
这就是你的年龄。

Chandler: Did I teach her that?
我有这么教她吗？ Did I just...
难道我刚刚... impart wisdom?
传授智慧？

Monica: (embraces Emma tightly) Ooh, I want one...
（紧紧拥抱艾玛）哦，我想要一个......

Chandler: Me too...
我也是...

(There's a couple of seconds of silence. Then Chandler looks around...)

Chandler: There's no-one around.
周围没人。 Why don't we just take this one?
我们为什么不只拿这个呢？

Monica: ...and head to Canada!
...前往加拿大！

Chandler: I was kidding.
我开玩笑的。

Monica: I wasn't.
我不是。 Let's get going!
我们出发吧！

(Phoebe enters the apartment again.)

Phoebe: Hey, are Ross and Rachel back?
嘿，罗斯和瑞秋回来了吗？

Chandler: No, not yet.
不，还没有。

Phoebe: Oh good, I didn't miss the party.
哦，太好了，我没有错过聚会。

Monica: What about your massage client?
你的按摩客户呢？

Phoebe: I just felt so bad, missing this.
我只是感觉很糟糕，错过了这个。 So I just slipped him a little something, you know.
所以我给他偷偷用了点药，你懂的。 As long as I'm back in five or six hours, it will be alright.
只要五六个小时后回来就可以了。

(Joey comes running into the apartment, out of breath.)

Joey: Okay, if Ross and Rachel ask, I've been here the whole time.
好吧，如果罗斯和瑞秋问起，我一直都在这里。 THE WHOLE TIME!
一直以来！

(Ross and Rachel enter.)

Joey: (to Ross and Rachel) I've been here the whole time!
（对罗斯和瑞秋）我一直都在这里！

Ross: Joey, we just saw you come in.
乔伊，我们刚刚看到你进来了。 You ran past us on the stairs.
你在楼梯上从我们身边跑过。

Rachel: I don't care that you left.
我不在乎你是否离开了。 I'm just glad that you're here.
我很高兴你在这里。 Thanks you guys!
谢谢你们！

Chandler: Hey, guys!
嘿，伙计们！ Come on!
快点！ You gotta see what Emma just did.
你得看看艾玛刚刚做了什么。

Rachel: What?
什么？

Chandler: Emma, how old are you?
艾玛，你几岁了？ How old are you today?
你今天几岁了？ (holds up his index finger again)

Emma: Wo-ish.
一……岁。 (and holds up her finger)

(Ross and Rachel gasp)

Rachel: Oh!
哦！ Emma, that's right!
艾玛，没错！ You're that many!
对，你就是这个岁数！

Ross: Oh my God!
我的天啊！ Our daughter's a genius!
我们的女儿是个天才！ Rach, this means...
瑞秋，这意味着……

Rachel: (angrily) NO, no science camp!
（生气地）不，不许送她去科学营！

Ross: Damnit!
该死的！ I'll put a candle on the cake.
我会在蛋糕上放一支蜡烛。

Rachel: Oh!...
哦！... Oh and Emma, look at your stuffed animals lined up so neatly!
哦，艾玛，看看你的毛绒动物排列得如此整齐！

Monica: Thanks!
谢谢！

Ross: Okay, here we go!
好的，我们开始吧！ Emma's first birthday cake...
艾玛的第一个生日蛋糕... Well hey...
嗯嘿... well, blow out the candle.
好吧，吹灭蜡烛。 Come on Emma.
来吧，艾玛。

Chandler: Let's do it, come on!
我们来做吧，加油！

(Rachel wipes away some tears.)

Ross: What's wrong?
怎么了？ Are you okay?
你还好吗？

Rachel: Oh yeah, nothing!
哦，是的，没什么！ These are happy tears!
这是幸福的泪水！ This is just what I wanted.
这正是我想要的。

Phoebe: (pointing at cake) Hey, you made it into a bunny.
（指着蛋糕）嘿，你把它变成了一只兔子。

Joey: What is wrong with me.
我是怎么了。 It looked more delicious when it was a penis.
当它是阴茎时看起来更美味。

ENDING CREDITS

[Scene: Rachel and Joey's apartment. It's just Ross and Rachel. They put the camera on a tripod in the kitchen and they are standing in front of the camera.]

Rachel: Okay.
好的。

Ross: Okay, you ready?
好吧，你准备好了吗？

Rachel: Yeah.
是的。

Ross: A-a-and...
那——就…… record.
开始录。

Rachel: Okay.
好的。 (they both look into the camera, and Ross waves.) Hi Emma.
（他们都看着镜头，罗斯挥手。）嗨，艾玛。 Well, your first birthday is over, and it was really...
好吧，你的第一个生日结束了，这真的是......

(There's a lot of yelling and screaming coming from the hallway, and they get up to look at what's the noise all about. In the hallway, Monica, Chandler, Joey and Phoebe are having another wind-up animal race, yelling and screaming fanatically.)

Phoebe: (yelling at the top of her voice) Go, go, go Alan!
（扯着嗓子喊）加油，加油，艾伦！ Run you, hairy bastard!
快跑吧，毛茸茸的混蛋！

end
